title: GNC Engineer Intern - Robust RL
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As a GNC Intern, you will join a team that has spent several months building AI-based guidance, navigation and control tools. Your mission is to understand where our AI control model is strong and where it breaks, then make it robust enough for the demands of high-speed flight. You will work at the interface between advanced theory and real-world application, from overnight training runs to flight test days. Responsibilities Literature Review: Conduct theoretical and applied literature reviews on the robustness of AI models. Model Diagnostics: Apply the most relevant methods to study our control model and diagnose its weaknesses. Training Strategies: Set up targeted training strategies to strengthen the model against extreme operating conditions. Experimentation & Analysis: Launch and analyze training runs, documenting results to guide subsequent iterations. Benchmark Performance: Improve performance on control benchmarks compared to the existing model. Tooling & Embedded Integration: Develop new tools within the training framework and streamline model integration onto embedded systems. Flight Testing & Data Processing: Prepare hardware, support live flight tests, and post-process collected data. Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with the GNC team to bring your findings into the wider product. Candidate Requirements Educational Background: A strong academic record, ideally with a specialization in Computer Science, AI, or Robotics. Technical Agility: A range of software projects showing you adapt quickly to new frameworks. Mindset: Curious, resourceful, and enthusiastic, with a clear motivation for applying AI to real-world control problems. Adaptability & Mobility: Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced, dynamic environment; embraces a “no-task-is-too-small” mentality. Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of collaborating effectively across all levels—from junior members to senior executives. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.
